snippet.title: Nonplace - Indie Horror Game - No Commentary
snippet.description:
Thanks For Watching!

Facebook https://www.facebook.com/Stella-Abbasi-100150965166877/
Twitter https://twitter.com/StellaAbbasi

Download https://deadpetalgames.itch.io/nonplace

You find yourself in the Nonplace, a twisted regurgitation of the real world tucked between time, there are no laws of science or religion.

There is no Devil, and no God here.

Document what you can and know that you are an unwelcome visitor.

Indie Horror Game Playlist https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLk0tZ0YT3FZEsIgd3Qdj19xGe9VcMMI1P

#nonplace #Indiegames
